package.author: Kilo Code Inc.
package.description: The open source agentic coding CLI from the Kilo engineering platform, built for baseline x86-64 CPUs.

en-US.author: Kilo Code Inc.
en-US.description: The open source agentic coding CLI from the Kilo engineering platform, built for baseline x86-64 CPUs.
en-US.longDescription: Kilo is the standalone agent CLI of the Kilo agentic engineering platform, the open source coding agent for building, shipping, and iterating on software. This is the baseline build, targeting older x86-64 CPUs without newer instruction-set extensions. It plans, edits, and executes engineering work directly in the terminal with support for tree-sitter language parsing and sandboxed task execution.
en-US.name: Kilo (Baseline)

zh-CN.description: Kilo 工程平台的开源智能体编码 CLI，面向基线 x86-64 CPU 构建。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kilo 是 Kilo 智能体工程平台的开源编码智能体独立 CLI，可在终端中直接规划、编辑和执行工程任务，支持 tree-sitter 语言解析与沙箱化任务执行。此为基线（baseline）构建，面向不支持较新指令集的旧款 x86-64 CPU。
